# Envoy

> Your private AI agent to the cloud. Envoy practises Privacy-Conscious Delegation: an on-device model in Chrome (via Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference) reads a private document and the user's question first, shares only the clauses the question needs with identities replaced by meaning-preserving tags, lets the user approve exactly what leaves, and restores the real values in the answer on the device.

Built for the Firebase #BuildHybridAI 2026 hackathon. Open source under Apache-2.0.

## How it works

- Detect, minimize and route run with `InferenceMode.ONLY_ON_DEVICE`, behind Envoy's own device guard (it checks Chrome's `LanguageModel`, blocks the cloud endpoint during private steps, and rejects answers that did not come from the device; this works around firebase-js-sdk issue #10635).
- The user reviews "What the cloud will see" and approves it; an outbound guard blocks any raw personal detail.
- Reasoning uses `InferenceMode.PREFER_IN_CLOUD` (cloud model from Remote Config); amounts the cloud needs are returned as expressions like `{{RENT * 1.10}}` and computed on the device.
- Simple factual questions are answered on the device with zero cloud calls. Without the on-device model, Envoy uses Basic protection (local rules only) and never falls back to sending raw text.
